name: How do I choose between a traditional flush toilet and a composting toilet for my tiny home?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a traditional flush toilet and a composting toilet for my tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a flush toilet and a composting toilet for your tiny home depends on your water access, waste disposal preferences, and living style. Flush toilets require a reliable water source and connection to a septic system or municipal sewer, offering a familiar experience. Composting toilets, conversely, are ideal for off-grid living or areas with water restrictions, as they require no water and convert waste into compost material. They do require regular emptying and proper ventilation. Consider your home's infrastructure and your comfort with maintenance when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: The choice between flush and composting toilets depends on water access, waste disposal options, and lifestyle. Flush toilets need water and sewer/septic, while composting toilets are waterless and require manual emptying.
